events.title: Boxwood Festival 2026
events.description: Boxwood Festival Canada brings a week of concerts, dances, sessions, and immersive hands-on workshops in traditional and early music to the town of Lunenburg. Whether you join for a single event, a day, or the entire week, you'll be part of an unforgettable celebration of musical discovery. Explore the roots and branches of our shared musical heritage alongside a community of world-class tradition bearers.

events.title: Boxwood Festival
events.description: The Boxwood Festival brings exceptional musicians from around the world to Lunenburg for a celebration of traditional music. Enjoy live performances featuring fiddle, flute, and more, all set in an intimate and inspiring setting. Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to traditional music, this event offers an unforgettable cultural experience Please note, in the event of rain, the event will be cancelled.
